title: How Egyptians Caught Tomb Raiders
hook: Breaking into a Pharaoh's tomb carried the gruesome death penalty of impalement on a wooden stake.

scenes.text: The Valley of the Kings held incalculable wealth in solid gold, lapis lazuli, and fine linen—making it the prime target for daring thieves.

scenes.text: During the 20th Dynasty, high inflation caused rampant tomb looting, leading to famous court trials recorded on the Mayer Papyrus.

scenes.text: Grave robbers tunneled through solid rock by fire-setting, burning the wooden coffins inside to quickly melt and peel off pure gold leaf.

scenes.text: To extract confessions, royal judges used 'bastinado': beating suspects on the soles of their feet and twisting their hands with wooden batons.
